उन्होंने हाल ही में Lexus LM 350h Ultra Luxury 4-Seater कार की डिलीवरी ली है। 🚘🔥
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक इस लग्जरी कार की कीमत लगभग 3.42 करोड़ रुपये बताई जा रही है! 💰😲
यह हाई-एंड MPV कार अपने शानदार और बड़े इंटीरियर स्पेस के लिए जानी जाती है। 👌
क्या आपको भी महंगी गाड़ियों का ऐसा ही कलेक्शन पसंद है? कमेंट्स में बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Rakesh Roshan adds a Rs 3.42 crores Lexus LM 350h to his luxury car collection
ctx.summary:
Veteran filmmaker and actor Rakesh Roshan has added a new luxury vehicle to his car collection. The filmmaker recently took delivery of the 2026 Lexus LM 350h Ultra Luxury 4-Seater, reportedly priced at around Rs 3.42 crores. The high-end multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) is known for its spacious interiors, premium features and focus on passenger comfort. The delivery reportedly took place in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, where Roshan's latest automobile purchase caught the attention of paparazzi and automobile enthusiasts. The Lexus LM 350h is among the luxury MPVs that have gained attention in India, particularly among celebrities and business personalities who prefer chauffeur-driven vehicles with enhanced privacy and comfort. The 2026 Lexus LM 350h Ultra Luxury 4-Seater is designed to offer a lounge-like experience for rear-seat passengers. One of its key features is a partition separating the driver's cabin from the rear passenger section, allowing occupants to travel with greater privacy. The rear cabin comes with fully reclining ottoman seats that also offer massage functions, adding to the vehicle's comfort-focused features.
